verdict.overall: Since Sunday the biggest mover is TSLA, up 7.4% to $399.81, yet its options positioning still leans OPPOSING across all four weeks, working against further upside. META, NVDA, ZETA and PLTR all pulled back in price with their magnet and ceiling levels sliding lower too, though some opposing readings for PLTR, NVDA and ZETA eased to neutral. The steadiest range setups remain AVGO, MU, AMAT and the index trackers SPY/QQQ, all holding calm NEUTRAL readings, while AMD, PLTR, NVDA, ZETA, AMAT and APP all carry earnings inside the next four weeks, adding event risk and several carry pricey options. Confidence in the quieter NEUTRAL names looks steady, but confidence in trend-driven names like TSLA and META is lower given the pullbacks and persistent opposing or falling levels.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: little changed in tone — price surged 7.4% to $399.81, but options for all four weeks still read OPPOSING, meaning positioning works against more upside. Ceilings rose with price (now $400-450) but resistance rose too. Nearest-week options are pricey.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: little changed — price up 1.4% to $326, options stay NEUTRAL across all four weeks. Magnet levels hold near $340-350, floors near $300-320, ceilings $340-365. A fairly settled range for swing trades, though the trend is still pointed down.
tickers.META: Since Sunday: weaker — price fell 4.3% to $615, pulling magnet levels down from the high $600s-700s to roughly $637-650, and ceilings dropped from the $700s-730 toward $645-700. Still NEUTRAL, floors steady near $585-610. Downtrend and oversold RSI add caution.
tickers.AMD: Since Sunday: weaker — price down 2.3% to $505, magnets and floors slipped slightly, nearest week now a $560 magnet, $450 floor, $575 ceiling. Mid-November stays OPPOSING ($480 magnet). Earnings land 11-03, right before the first expiry, and nearest options are pricey.
tickers.MU: Since Sunday: little changed — price up 0.8% to $885, magnets drifted down slightly (e.g. $975 to $950) but stayed NEUTRAL with floors/ceilings roughly steady near $800-1000. A fairly calm range setup; earnings not due until December.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: weaker on price (down 6.4% to $184), but the options mood actually eased — mid-November flipped from OPPOSING to NEUTRAL, with floor and ceiling sliding down with price ($180 floor, $202.5-210 ceiling). Earnings hit 11-02, before the first expiry, and options are pricey.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: weaker — price down 3% to $205, magnets and ceilings eased slightly (nearest ceiling $230 to $225), though the 11-20 week improved from OPPOSING to NEUTRAL. Floors steady near $190-200. Earnings land 11-17, squarely inside this window, and some weeks are pricey.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: weaker — price dropped 8.3% to $31.17, with the nearest floor falling from $33 to $30, though mid-November eased from OPPOSING to NEUTRAL. Magnets hold near $32-33, ceilings fell too. Earnings due 11-09 and options are very pricey throughout — real caution.
tickers.AMAT: Since Sunday: stronger on price (up 3.4% to $390) even as magnets eased down slightly ($450 to $420 nearest week) and ceilings crept up ($400 to $420). Still NEUTRAL across all weeks, floor steady near $350-370. Earnings due 11-12, inside this window.
tickers.APP: No Sunday baseline. Versus the prior run, price is little changed near $228.50, still NEUTRAL across all four weeks with a wide magnet band ($280-300) well above price and floor support near $200-220. Earnings land 11-04, inside this window, and options are very pricey.
tickers.SPY: Since Sunday: little changed — price down 0.6% to $755.72, magnets and ceilings eased slightly (nearest ceiling $805 to $788). Still NEUTRAL throughout. In GBP (VUSA) nearest week: magnet about £109.38, floor £106.68, ceiling £112.09. Options are pricey and the trend is down.
tickers.QQQ: Since Sunday: weaker — price down 2% to $690.49, nearest-week magnet eased ($725 to $720) and the following week's ceiling fell further ($800 to $755). Still NEUTRAL throughout.
